html: Having a regular creative practice – music, writing, crafting, painting or whatever your preferred medium may be – has been shown to increase your overall sense of wellbeing. And, as the Australian artist and YouTube creator Campbell Walker (aka Struthless) discusses in this whimsical homespun video, in our era of infinite social feeds, making things has the added benefit of liberating you from the dreaded doom-scroll. Keeping in mind that, often, just getting started is the hardest part of creative work, Walker offers 10 crafty ideas – including ‘turn a mistake into art’ and ‘answer famous questions’ – to overcome the obstacles of fatigue, overwhelm, and perfectionism, and get the creative juices flowing.
